title: Migrate Pi and Git helper roots
summary: Move Pi distribution integration and Git/content-evidence helpers toward target src/pi and src/git roots using generic extension mechanisms.

goal.outcome: Pi integration and Git/content-evidence behavior move toward generic src/pi and src/git roots without dogfood-specific code paths.
acceptance: src/pi/** owns Pi commands/tools/ui/prompt/compaction surfaces or direct owner modules migrated from src/adapters/pi/**.
src/git/** owns content evidence, worktree, and publisher helper surfaces or direct owner modules migrated from runtime/gc/gateway compatibility roots.
Generic reload/worktree/publication evidence behavior remains project-config-driven, not hard-coded for this repository.
Existing package entrypoints and Pi extension discovery continue to work after migration.
Tests cover Pi/tool registration or package loading and Git/content-evidence helper behavior where applicable.
non_goals: Do not add CodeWiki-repo-specific dogfood behavior.
Do not change package distribution semantics except compatibility-safe imports/entrypoints.
Do not implement planning/implementation/graph root migrations in this task.
verification: targeted TASK-120 Pi/Git root migration test

delta.desired: src/pi and src/git own their target surfaces through generic extension mechanisms.
delta.current: Pi integration remains under src/adapters/pi/** and Git/content-evidence helpers are spread across runtime/gc/gateway compatibility roots.
delta.closure: Closed when Pi/Git roots exist with package/source-contract evidence and no dogfood special cases.
